title: Solar system 太阳系 [ 3D/4k/自定义]
description:
”可以直接在屏幕上单击时间唤出滑块调整视角距离和角度！！！“

如果遇到光照或者帧率不理想问题可以尝试：
1.后处理选择禁用或启用而不是高，这张壁纸的表现并不依赖处理
2.帧率60帧最佳，其余设置都可以让步降低

此壁纸尽量在现实物理规律和艺术表达上做了平衡：
1.采用圆形而非椭圆形轨道，轨道半径做了艺术化处理；
2.天体的体积做了艺术化处理，但大小顺序没有变化 ；
3. 行星和卫星的公转轨道倾角均与现实一致 ；
4.天体的运行速度可以调节成和现实的太阳系各个天体的运行速度成正比关系，但我做了非线性和线性的变换，使之适于壁纸以作观赏（虽然可以调节，但我不建议调整 ）
5.只是个简单壁纸，请勿被误导！

理论上三个参数均为1时，系统内的天体运行周期会和现实的太阳系成倍速关系，但我不建议这么做，因为海王星天王星运行速度会极其微小的同时卫星却在疯狂运转。所以非必要请勿调整其中参数

感谢订阅和点赞~
有问题可以在此反馈，尽力修复。

Translation:
"You can now click the time directly on the screen to bring up a slider for adjusting perspective distance and angle!!!"

For lighting or frame rate optimization:
   1.Post-processing: Set to Disabled/Enabled instead of High (visual quality doesn't rely on post-processing)
   2.Frame rate: Target 60 FPS as the priority. Other settings can be moderately reduced if needed.

This wallpaper strives to balance realism in physical laws with artistic expression:
   1.Circular rather than elliptical orbits are adopted
   2.Celestial bodies are artistically scaled while maintaining their relative size hierarchy
   3.Orbital inclinations of planets and moons align with actual astronomical parameter
   4.Celestial movement speeds can be adjusted proportionally to reality, but I've implemented nonlinear/linear transformations for optimal wallpaper aesthetics. Though adjustable, modification is not recommended.
   5.This is merely a simplified wallpaper - please do not take it as an astronomical reference!

Theoretical note: When the following three parameters are all set to 1, the system's orbital periods would maintain proportional relationships with our solar system. However, this configuration is strongly advised against, as it would result in Neptune/Uranus moving at imperceptible speeds while their moons rotate frenetically. Please avoid adjusting these parameters unless absolutely necessary:

• Planetary angular velocity linear transformation
• Planetary angular velocity nonlinear decay
• Lunar angular velocity linear attenuation

Thank you for your support!
 If you encounter a bug during the customization process, please reset the wallpaper first and give me feedback;

更新：

2025/4/1 更新视角滑块位置和大小可调，新增了天体基本信息
2025/4/2 修改了体积光在某些设备上不显示的bug：将太阳更换成了实体模型

title: Neptune Live2D
description:
[b]The ultimate Live2D wallpaper![/b]

[b]Please watch the video tutorial above before using this wallpaper[/b]


[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Character interactions - cursor following, touching, greeting
[*]Effects - falling leaves, snowfall
[*]Moving / scaling / layering character(s)
[*]Multi-language subtitles
[*]Custom Live2D models
[*]Custom image and video backgrounds
[*]Custom theming and seasonal theming
[*]Localization supported
[*]FPS control
[/list]


[h1]Using Custom Live2D Models[/h1]

[b]There's a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1078208425/4891437254530488483/]detailed guide[/url] for adding new models.[/b]

Since v2.1.0, models can be imported by folder. In this way, the [i]model.json[/i] file no longer needs to have the same name as its folder, furthermore, it doesn't even have to exist, but note that models imported without [i]model.json[/i] will only get basic features supported.

Now there are two ways to import models—by file and by folder. By file you can import models that have a [i]model.json[/i] file, while by folder you can import any supported models.

The only drawback of folder importing is that the folder picker cannot remember last selected location, which means you have to manually navigate into project directory every time to make a selection. This behaviour is caused by CEF, the internal browser, and unable to fix until Wallpaper Engine upgrades CEF to newer version.

Regular models of Live2D 2.1 are now supported via folder importing. If a model seems to incorrectly fit its frame (visible while dragging), you can modify the parameters' values in [b]layout[/b] in [i]model.json[/i] file, or simply delete all those parameters in order to use default values.


[h1]Live2D Resources[/h1]
Some newer models of Neptunia series can be found [url=https://www.spriters-resource.com/mobile/mainichicompileheart/]here[/url]. Unlike built-in old ones, these models have no hit area defined on body, so clicking on head will start a motion, and clicking on mouth will change the expression.

Some models that are already adapted for this wallpaper: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1078208425/1496741765138859384/]Nepgear[/url] by CelloD, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1078208425/1480982971172461474/]Norie[/url] by Beat Hazardous T.L. and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1078208425/1621724915768496597/]Blanc[/url] by Adamu-kun, thanks for their nice work!

To adapt a model yourself, see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1078208425/1471966894862720611/]this guide[/url].


[h1]Troubleshooting[/h1]
When encountering any unexpected behaviour on this wallpaper, you can try reloading the wallpaper by clicking the refresh button (top-right of settings panel) or re-select this wallpaper in Wallpaper Engine browser.

If problem still exists, try pressing the [b]Reset[/b] button in [b]Console[/b] tab of settings panel, this is useful most of the time. An additional step is to reset this wallpaper's properties in Wallpaper Engine browser, but it's usually unnecessary.

You can also post an issue report if you like, we always appreciate it. But it'll be better to provide more detailed information, here is a template:
[list]
[*]The problem, and how you got it
[*]Error messages if existing (Check if there are any red texts from logs in [b]Console[/b] tab of settings panel)
[*]Hardware and software environment, such as the monitor (resolution? refresh rate? multiple monitors?)
[/list]


[h1]Latest Update: v2.1.1[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added option to disable start-up greeting
[*]Fixed rendering error caused by certain Live2D models
[/list]
